name: A Werewolf in Charleston
source:
The United States is facing a crisis.

Werewolves roam in the nation's shadows, attacking unsuspecting humans. But is that the full story? Tensions between humans and werewolves are tightening their grip on the country ever further.

And when Anthony "Andy" Crane--the son of a Charleston bishop--discovers a shocking truth about himself, he is thrust right into that conflict. His presence will spark more friction in the city's "war on werewolves." To make matters worse, his body is changing, and he must choose which side to embrace before he is destroyed from the inside.

[From [url=https://rhettoeraven.itch.io/a-werewolf-in-charleston]Itch.io[/url]]
